title: Hierarchy enumeration must include nonvisual occurrences
task_type: Unity Editor asset and build verification
environment: Public synthetic semantic hierarchy in Unity 2022.3.22f1/Blender 5.2.1. This checkpoint alone did not prove native Skin, renderer or bone attachment parity.
goal: Reconstruct a complete semantic hierarchy from nested prefabs.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Renderer-driven model expansion was assumed to cover the semantic hierarchy.
what_worked: Historical correction: Expand source objects using root context and ordered instance edges, retaining source object/transform identities independently of renderers. Verification reported by the source: Normal import changed from zero to two nested occurrences. All 48 oracle dimensions matched; rename/save/reopen retained semantic identity. Malformed-source and comparator controls passed.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: An independent Unity oracle had 12 nodes and 11 edges, while normal import produced 10 and 9; two renderer-free occurrences were absent.
why: Confirmed: prefab-local object/nested-occurrence expansion omitted nodes with no renderer.
improved_method: Compare complete independent node populations, including repeated nonvisual nodes. Never make semantic hierarchy existence depend on renderable content.
when_to_use: Public synthetic semantic hierarchy in Unity 2022.3.22f1/Blender 5.2.1. This checkpoint alone did not prove native Skin, renderer or bone attachment parity.
when_not_to_use: This checkpoint alone did not prove native Skin, renderer or bone attachment parity.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
